feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
entry.summary: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop would have been greater, but women over age 30 are having more children.

entry.title: Severe flooding hits Four Corners region, more expected through the weekend
entry.summary: Intense rainfall slammed the Four Corners region late this week. As rivers flooded, towns declared evacuations and emergencies and made rescues.

entry.title: Video released in Mississippi police shooting of toddler
entry.summary: The police officer involved in a shooting in Mississippi and killed a toddler has resigned a day after video of the incident was released.

entry.title: Father who killed the Bend school shooter speaks to Oregon Public Broadcasting
entry.summary: Kaylub Giamanco, the father who shot the 16-year-old who opened fire on a Bend, Ore., elementary school and killed three kids and a teacher, shares what he wants people to know about his experience.

entry.title: The Pentagon's guidelines for "responsible AI" aren't always followed, report shows
entry.summary: The Pentagon is building weapons and projects with AI capabilities that officials say don't always closely adhere to the agency's own guidelines for AI, according to a congressional watchdog report published in October.

entry.title: Ohio could decide control of the Senate. Its rural voters might decide the winner
entry.summary: Ohio has been a reliably red state for several elections but it's competitive this year. If Democrats want to prevail, they'll have to win people who have backed Republicans, like rural voters.

entry.title: A D.C. park was made 'for the pleasure of the people.' Trump's plan would change that
entry.summary: Trump's most recent rendering of East Potomac Park overtakes the D.C. peninsula with a sprawling golf course, without the grassy areas and road beloved by locals. That's prompted grassroots pushback.

entry.title: Gen Z is 'in the thick' of high housing costs. These candidates aim to solve it
entry.summary: Young candidates who rent or live with parents say their generation is "in the thick" of the country's housing affordability crisis. They argue this gives them new energy to solve it for everyone.

entry.title: Jet fuel prices hit a record and holiday airfares soar higher
entry.summary: If you're planning to fly this holiday season, be prepared to pay more than you did last year. The price of jet fuel — one of airlines' biggest expenses — is at an all-time high in the U.S.

entry.title: What's behind the early voting surge? It's more than voter enthusiasm, expert says
entry.summary: Nearly 21 million Americans have voted early in the midterms. MIT political scientist Charles Stewart explains what's driving the surge and why it may not mean higher overall turnout.
